messages:
maya: hey devex — during a new-user onboarding run the sampleapp (node) is printing raw correlation ids in logs even though LOG_SCRUB=true. noticed this on debug and info levels. @kris any idea? :eyes:
kris: did you repro with python sample too or just node?
maya: only node so far. steps: `git checkout sampleapp/onboard`, `yarn start`, create a request via curl. logs show header `X-Correlation-ID: abc-123-456-tenantA` in plaintext.
samir: might be an OTEL hook ordering problem — our log-scrubber is an express middleware but the SDK's otel-shim registers after it, so the scrub runs before context/trace attachment. also, the auth retry path can re-insert headers during refresh.
sophie: fwiw I hit a parity gap: python SDK wires a LogEmitter sanitizer via OTEL, node relies on an app-level middleware. we should unify so quickstarts are safe by default.
maya: what's the short-term fix we can ship to make onboarding safe? customers will see sensitive ids in logs.
kris: short-term: set `DEFAULT_LOG_LEVEL=warn` in the quickstart image to avoid noisy prints. medium-term: call `registerLogSanitizer()` from `sdk.init()` or ensure `otel.init()` runs before sanitizer middleware.
sophie: example order that worked for me:
```
// pseudo
app.use(otelMiddleware()); // attach tracer/context
app.use(logSanitizer());   // redacts req/res fields based on config
app.use(routes);
```
if you reverse those it can miss context-bound headers.
maya: also noticed auth-retry loses the correlation header on 401 -> refresh path. `auth-retry` rebuilds headers and doesn't preserve the redact flag, so scrub is skipped.
samir: good catch. our `fetchWithRetry()` clones headers but sets `skipSanitize: true` in internal opts. fix: preserve `x-correlation-id` but mark it redacted before logging; do not skip the sanitizer.
kris: @maya can you add a tiny repro snippet to the issue with a few sample logs (redact the real ids)? I'll file an SDK parity task.
maya: done — opened https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/issues/122 with logs, curl commands, and `env=LOG_SCRUB=true` reproduction steps.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: sampleapp-staging updated to image sha:sha123 - deploy started
sophie: :thumbsup: I can PR a node sdk init that wires sanitizer into the otel init hook and add a short onboarding doc note.
samir: quick checklist for the PR: - ensure sanitizer runs in dev and prod - add tests for info-level logs (verify scrub runs) - handle auth-retry header cloning - add e2e that runs quickstart with LOG_SCRUB=true
maya: putting this on today's sprint. tagging @kris for SDK release window.
kris: thanks all. I'll coordinate release with eng-releases. ETA tomorrow morning.
